facts.fact: The ministry says the Transitional Legislative Assembly examined and adopted the bill on unique electronic identification of natural persons at its plenary of 11 October 2024.
facts.system: Law on unique electronic identification of natural persons

BFA.note: Gives one in four without an identity document and a 80% enrolment target for 2026, not an enrolled count.

facts.fact: The minister said the unique identifier is a random number to be assigned to every Burkinabe from birth, at home or abroad, and to every foreigner resident in the country.
facts.system: Unique electronic identification of natural persons (WURI)

facts.fact: The minister said measures are being taken so that management of the unique identification system is entrusted to local expertise.
facts.system: Unique electronic identification of natural persons (WURI)

BFA.note: Says the number will serve as base for other sectors' identification systems; no register named.

facts.fact: The ministry says the WURI project is building a unique electronic identification system, costing over 48 billion, aiming to enrol 80% of the population free of charge by 2026.
facts.system: Unique electronic identification of natural persons (WURI)
